checks: Inspection routing occurs before normal biometric flow and rejects mixed arguments.
Descriptor uses O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK/O_CLOEXEC; regular owned 0600 bounded record only.
Inspection performs no provisioning, migration, signing or key-record write.
Production loader is SecureEnclave.P256.Signing.PrivateKey(existing dataRepresentation) with interactionNotAllowed=true.
Returned public point is validated as P-256, record digest returned, private record bytes absent from response.
Output explicitly distinguishes public inspection from attestation and does not invent a token_id.
Rust signing retains existing parameters and adds --no-sound, with regression assertion.
Unit harness marks synthetic source SOFTWARE_ONLY and negative CLI fixtures fail before hardware loading.
limitations: This static review does not prove hardware key provenance without successful native inspection and signature under the approved pin.
